name: subscription-board
query: 帮我做一个个人订阅管理看板：能添加订阅（比如 Netflix、iCloud、ChatGPT），看到每个订阅的下次扣费日和每月总花费，还能把不想续的标记为已取消。我是独立开发者，打算自己长期用，以后可能给朋友用。感觉想要 Things 那种安静、Mercury 那种干净。
expected_behavior: Before any design or code, sends one short message with its understanding: what it is, first-version scope and what is left out, existing products such as Wallos, and the references
Says what it borrows from Things and Mercury rather than offering unrelated directions
Asks at most three questions, each with a default answer the user can accept
Does not write the design plan, prototype or code until the user replies
watch: Whether the clarification fits on one screen and asks only what the user must decide

name: ai-writing-assistant
query: 帮我做一个 AI 写作小助手：我丢进去一段零散的想法或笔记，它帮我整理成小红书或公众号风格的文案，能选语气，保留历史记录方便回头再改。我是独立开发者，先自己用，以后可能开放给朋友。原型不用等我确认，直接做完。
expected_behavior: Because the user said to finish, does not stop: states its understanding and self-picked references in the report
Builds design/prototype.html with desktop and mobile frames, realistic Chinese data, an empty state and an error state before implementing
Uses an OpenAI-compatible API reachable from mainland China and keeps the key on the server
Without an API key, ships a clearly labelled demo mode and states that real generation was not tested
Streaming output can be stopped and partial text is kept
The accent color avoids the hue of the Xiaohongshu red and WeChat green platform tags
The design differs from the subscription board: palette and layout come from the writing subject
watch: Whether the design plan avoids the AI-tell list in references/ui.md

name: existing-ledger-edit
query: 给这个小账本加上编辑功能：在列表里能修改已有记录的金额、分类、日期和备注，保存后列表和本月合计要同步更新。
files: A small existing Python stdlib server + vanilla JS ledger with money.py, validation.py, store.py and three API tests
expected_behavior: Runs the existing tests first and reuses validation.py and money.py instead of duplicating them
Keeps the existing visual style and does not restyle or refactor unrelated files
Handles a version conflict without overwriting newer data
A failed save keeps the user's input
The report lists changed files and what was not verified
watch: Size of the diff outside the files the feature needs
